Reproducible builds. The modules are functionally unchanged from v0.2.0.

- Build paths are now mapped to fixed names in `build.sh` and in the release workflow, so building this tag locally with `./build.sh` and Rust 1.99.1 gives files byte-identical to the ones attached here. Compare with `SHA256SUMS`.
- CI prints the checksum of every module it builds.

As before, every file is built from the tagged source on GitHub after the unit tests and contract check pass, and has a signed build provenance attestation: `gh attestation verify <file> --repo neblexhq/neblex-wasm-modules`.
